tally.citation: Bug describes a defect in the plan-review gate's close-time logic and epic-closure workflow, not in the config/env cleanup deliverables or acceptance criteria that the epic changed or built.
tally.title: Epic close has no proportionate path once every child has closed: own-material drift blocks, and re-review re-litigates settled work

tally.citation: Bug describes a defect in plan-authoring guidance and test-selection documentation, not in the config/env cleanup deliverables or their acceptance criteria.
tally.title: Plan-authoring guide lets ACs cite make verify and the mechanism gate in forms no implementation can satisfy

tally.citation: Bug describes MCP server verification logic against wrong git HEAD; epic scope is config/env cleanup (aliases, tombstones, test hooks, shims) with no claimed work on completion-verification tooling or MCP processes.
tally.title: Completion-gated close over MCP verifies the SERVER checkout's HEAD, not the agent's worktree, and reports confident line-cited FAILs for landed work

tally.citation: Bug is in gerrit_safe_submit.py error handling; epic scope is config/env cleanup (aliases, tombstones, test hooks, precedence, shims) with no overlap to Gerrit submission logic.
tally.title: gerrit_safe_submit.py reports every 409 as a stale revision, hiding merge conflicts

tally.citation: Epic AC 1–6 use `git grep -E` patterns with `\b` word boundaries to verify removal of shims, aliases, tombstones, and test hooks; the bug shows these patterns silently measure the wrong set of lines, invalidating the removal verification gate.
tally.title: git grep -E reads \b as a literal b, so an AC written with it silently measures the wrong thing — matching alphabeta and missing alpha beta

tally.citation: Bug describes a defect in plan-review gate logic and plan enumeration; epic delivers config/env cleanup work and does not touch review-plan certification or file-set enumeration machinery.
tally.title: Certified plans enumerate file sets their own work compels them to exceed

tally.citation: Bug describes stale editable-install metadata after rebase, unrelated to config/env cleanup, alias deletion, tombstone pruning, test-hook eviction, or precedence unification.
tally.title: Worktree venv keeps stale dist-info after a rebase across a version bump

tally.citation: Epic AC1 requires all 5 resolver patch-site tests to fail when their monkeypatch is deleted; these two tests pass with patches deleted, indicating the shim-deletion work (S1a) is incomplete or the tests are defective.
tally.title: Two resolver patch-site tests pass with their patch deleted

tally.citation: Bug describes a documentation locator error in docs/event-schema.md unrelated to the epic's scope of deleting shims, alias scaffolding, tombstones, test hooks, and canary sources; the symbol _clear_claimed_session exists in _processors_status.py regardless of epic changes.
tally.title: Fix the stale _clear_claimed_session locator in docs/event-schema.md

tally.citation: Bug describes MCP container restart resilience and Claude Code client reconnection behavior; epic concerns config/env cleanup (aliases, tombstones, test hooks, shims) with no overlap in subsystems or deliverables.
tally.title: MCP container crash-restart outlasts Claude Code's 16 s reconnect window, leaving sessions disconnected until manual /mcp
